description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit research lab inspection records, the facility’s internal and accreditation inspection record itself, with its findings, corrections and the facility record’s areas: the reading moment; each area the facility record identifies with its id, reference and name; each inspection entry with its id, reference, the area inspected, its kind (internal or accreditation) and the moment inspected; each finding with its id, reference, the inspection entry, the moment recorded and the earlier finding it repeats; each correction entry with its id, reference, the finding and the moments due and completed. The signed report gives the inspections and the records behind them, each finding against a correction entry, each correction past its due date against a completion, each repeated finding against the closure of the earlier correction, and each inspection entry against the areas the facility record identifies, and counts them, and names divergent research lab inspection records: a finding with no correction entry behind it, a correction past its due date with no completion entry, a finding repeated after its correction was closed, and an inspection entry for an area the facility record does not identify; then a correction naming a finding the record does not hold and a finding naming an inspection entry the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inspection entries, or no areas beside inspected areas, leaves those points unverified. Areas, inspections, findings and corrections match by letters and digits, dates by the day, and a correction due after the reading moment waits. This reads the inspection record kept on the facility; it inspects no facility and contacts no regulator or accreditor. Verdict researchlab_inspection_record_divergent, researchlab_inspection_record_partial, researchlab_inspection_record_unverified or researchlab_inspection_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-inspection-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.

areas.description: Each area the facility record identifies.

corrections.description: Each correction entry with its due and completion dates.

due_at.description: When the correction is due, such as 2026-03-02.

inspection_findings.description: Each finding the inspection record holds.

repeat_of.description: The earlier finding it repeats reference.

inspections.description: Each internal or accreditation inspection entry.

kind.description: An internal inspection or an accreditation inspection.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
